articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 34% improvement on SWE-Bench and near-human performance on graduate-level scientific reasoning tasks. The model also introduces a persistent memory layer that maintains context across sessions without explicit retrieval augmentation.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Automated Theorem Proving
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 has solved 78% of problems from the International Mathematical Olympiad 2026 qualifying set, a significant leap from last year's 62%. The system combines a chain-of-thought verifier with a reinforcement learning loop trained on formal proof assistants like Lean 4. Researchers say the approach generalizes to software verification and could transform how critical systems are formally validated.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Deployment in BMW Manufacturing Plants
articles.summary: BMW confirmed the first large-scale deployment of Tesla's Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots at its Spartanburg, South Carolina plant, with 200 units performing sub-assembly, materials handling, and quality inspection tasks. The robots leverage onboard vision-language models for zero-shot task adaptation, reducing reprogramming time from days to minutes. This marks the first major third-party industrial deployment of Optimus outside Tesla's own factories.

articles.title: Figure AI Demonstrates Autonomous Warehouse Robot Operating 20-Hour Shifts with 99.6% Pick Accuracy
articles.summary: Figure AI showcased its Figure 02 humanoid robot completing full warehouse pick-and-pack workflows autonomously across 20-hour shifts, achieving 99.6% accuracy across 15,000 SKU variations. The system uses a proprietary world model for spatial reasoning and dexterous manipulation of deformable and fragile objects. Several major logistics providers including DHL are reportedly in advanced procurement discussions.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Auditing Framework for Enterprise AI Compliance
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new open-source constitutional auditing toolkit that allows enterprises to formally specify, test, and certify behavioral guardrails on large language models before deployment. The framework integrates with CI/CD pipelines and generates compliance reports aligned with the EU AI Act and the newly enacted US AI Accountability Act. Early adopters report a 60% reduction in time-to-compliance for regulated industry deployments.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 gate-all-around (GAA) process node has entered volume production at its Kaohsiung fab, approximately two months ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node delivers a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from Nvidia, AMD, and Apple in 2027. Analysts note this cements TSMC's lead over Samsung Foundry, which has struggled with GAA yields.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with 4x Electrode Density
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to begin human trials of its N2 implant, which quadruples electrode density to 4,096 channels and incorporates on-chip signal processing to reduce wireless bandwidth requirements. The first cohort will focus on restoring full cursor and keyboard control for patients with spinal cord injuries. Independent reviewers noted significant improvements in biocompatibility and projected device longevity of over 10 years.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Electric with Real-Time LLM-Driven Task Planning
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics revealed a major Atlas Electric update integrating a locally-run large language model for real-time natural language task decomposition and planning in unstructured construction environments. In live demos, operators issued high-level verbal commands and the robot autonomously sequenced multi-step tasks including material transport, tool selection, and debris clearing. Hyundai announced plans to deploy 500 units across its construction and shipbuilding divisions by mid-2027.
